Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.loot

Class ItemDropper

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.loot.ItemDropper
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventListener
public final class ItemDropper extends Object implements EventListener
Puts items on the ground (GDD 1.4): the one entry point for an item appearing in the world. A monster's loot (Arena), the items of a room (Endless), the player's dropped items and the weapon or armor it swaps all go through it. It listens to ItemDropped, so a character only announces what falls and never creates the item on the ground itself.
